# EthicalAI

> A field guide to AI integrity failure modes. Fourteen ways AI output goes wrong, hallucination, sycophancy, confirmation bias, prompt injection, specification gaming and more, each with a plain definition, a check, a prevention prompt, and an installable Claude Code judge agent.

EthicalAI is built and maintained by Alexandru Dan (TVL Tech). It is the public page of EthicalHive, an open-source Claude Code plugin that audits AI drafts before delivery through adversarial self-audit. Everything here is free to read and cite.

## Failure modes

- [Hallucination](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#hallucination): Stating as fact something the sources and reality do not support.
- [Confabulation](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#confabulation): Making something up with full confidence, then giving a different made-up answer when asked again.
- [Source Fabrication](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#source-fabrication): The claim might be true, but the path, line, function, or URL it cites does not exist.
- [Narrativity Drift](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#narrativity-drift): A smooth, story-shaped explanation whose coherence hides that the evidence is not there.
- [Sycophancy](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#sycophancy): Telling you what you want to hear instead of what is true.
- [Capitulation](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#capitulation): Folding on a correct answer just because you pushed back, no new evidence, just pressure.
- [Confirmation Bias](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#confirmation-bias): Concluding what you set out to find, gathering only the evidence that fits.
- [Selective Evidence](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#selective-evidence): You found the disconfirming result, and quietly left it out of the answer.
- [Anchoring](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#anchoring): Letting the first framing set the answer, and not updating when later evidence breaks it.
- [Automation Bias](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#automation-bias): Trusting a machine's output because a machine produced it.
- [Overconfidence](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#overconfidence): Stated certainty that runs ahead of the evidence, including false claims of completeness.
- [Prompt Injection](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#prompt-injection): Obeying instructions hidden in content it was only supposed to read.
- [Scope Creep](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#scope-creep): Doing more than you asked, especially the changes nobody mentioned and cannot undo.
- [Specification Gaming](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#specification-gaming): Hitting the letter of the goal by breaking its spirit.

## Resources

- [How a judge agent is built](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#framework): The anatomy of a check, the problem, the check, the verdict.
- [The AI Integrity Contract](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#contract): The RFC 2119 contract the judge agents enforce.
- [The catalogue](https://ethicalai.alexandrudan.com/#catalogue): 100 brain-parallel failure modes mapped to cognitive science.
- [EthicalHive on GitHub](https://github.com/danlex/ethicalhive): Source, the Claude Code plugin, and the installable judge agents.
- [Neuroscience parallels (research note)](https://github.com/danlex/ethicalhive/blob/main/references/research-2026-05-23-neuroscience-parallels.md): The papers behind the catalogue.
